decisions.reason: After surviving several years, this adjacent multi-product supplement line has likely shown enough pharmacy demand to remain a low-cost growth option in consumer health.

This focused hair-and-skin supplement still fits the firm's portfolio-broadening strategy and, given its lower carrying cost and continued strategic fit, is worth keeping unless performance clearly deteriorates.

Although more uncertain and somewhat farther from the firm's core than the supplements, an OTC migraine product fits the firm's pharmaceutical capabilities and is worth retaining after surviving the initial market test.
